## Published WordPress.org Plugins

- [WP SVG Engine](https://wordpress.org/plugins/svigent-tools/): Official WordPress.org plugin (`svigent-tools`) enabling secure SVG & SVGZ uploads with server-side XML/DOM sanitization, Media Library preview fixes, dimension detection, and fast client-side inlining.
- [ClickReach – Social Share Buttons & Counter](https://wordpress.org/plugins/clickreach-social-share-buttons/): Official WordPress.org plugin (`clickreach-social-share-buttons`) providing lightweight inline-SVG social sharing buttons backed by a custom WordPress REST API click counter.
